decisions.reason: The rye country bread belongs to the firm's core traditional bread range and uses existing know-how and facilities, so management keeps defending the investment it has already made.
The premium raisin stollen is the publicly announced flagship and has won gold again, so both commitment and evidence strongly favor keeping it.

Product D is a niche variant with no reported success, but it uses the firm's existing bread competence and its weaker results can still be blamed on temporary demand conditions, so management persists for now.
The marzipan stollen rounds out the committed Christmas stollen line around the flagship, so dropping it would undermine the seasonal gift direction the firm has announced.
Having publicly presented the ancient grain bread as its newest masterpiece, management feels bound to justify that claim and give it more time to establish itself.
